title: HIVE Digital Technologies Ltd. Form 8-K - Exchangeable Senior Notes Offering and TSX Listing
summary: HIVE Digital Technologies Ltd. filed a Form 8-K on April 15, 2026, announcing a proposed private offering of $75 million aggregate principal amount of 0% exchangeable senior notes due 2031 through its wholly-owned subsidiary HIVE Bermuda 2026 Ltd.
